description: List security findings for the organisation as short rows. Filter by pentest, asset, repository, severity, client-visible status, source, confirmation type, assignee, CVSS range, or dormant assets. Search titles or human identifiers such as ODI-12. Call get_finding for one finding's detail.

assetId.description: Filter to findings whose latest revision references this asset.

assignee.description: Client user ID(s), or __unassigned__ to include findings without an assignee.

lean.description: With view full, exclude heavy evidence. The summary view never includes it.

liveProof.description: How far Odin got against the live app: exploited keeps findings Odin exploited live; not_exploited keeps every other pentest finding. PR review and dependency findings match neither.

repository.description: Filter to a source repository such as owner/name.

search.description: Free-text search on finding titles and human identifiers.

status.description: Filter by status. Odin shows MITIGATING as Fixing and ACKNOWLEDGED as Risk accepted; use those names with people. Open findings are REPORTED, MITIGATING, NEEDS_REVISION and OPEN_FOR_RETEST; FIXED_AND_RETESTED and ACKNOWLEDGED are closed.

view.description: summary (default) returns a short row per finding: IDs, title, severity, status, repository, assignee, linked pull request numbers and states, dates, and engineFinding for findings from Odin's automated pentests. full returns complete records, which are far larger; prefer get_finding for one finding's detail.

name: list_findings
title: List findings
